test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The travel agent asked whether I wanted to go by air or by sea.

options.text: The travel agent asked, “Did he want to go by air or sea?”
The travel agent asked, “Did you want to go by air or sea?”
The travel agent asked, “Do you want to go by air or sea?”
The travel agent asked, “How did you want to go by air or sea?”

solution:
The correct answer is **'****The travel agent asked, “Do you want to go by air or sea?”'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech.**
 
• The process of converting this sentence to direct speech is:
 
 
• Recognizing the speaker, **"the travel agent"**.
 
• Use of **"whether" **or **"if"** in the indirect speech indicates the direct speech will be an interrogative sentence.
 
• **"I wanted" **is a simple past tense. Hence the direct speech will be in **simple present tense “Do you want".**
 
• Identifying the reporting verb **'asked'**. In direct speech, it's typical to retain 'asked' when implying a question was put forth.
 
• The temporality and subject-person alignment** ('I' remains 'I') **of the question are preserved.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct direct speech is: *The travel agent asked, “Do you want to go by air or sea?”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s identify the reporting speech and reported speech.

 
 
• He said, “I go to school every day.”
 
• In the above sentence “He said” is the reporting speech.
 
• “I go to school every day.” is the reported speech.
